notes.title: La Galerie des Toilettes is OUT NOW!!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776558/516a1dd8d12aa05e21adf25f1e079a7061587911.png"][/img][/p][p]You have been given your ticket and let loose in a museum housing the finest collection of art lovingly dedicated to the human toilet.[/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][p]This game is short, so take your time to explore and contemplate each piece in the collection. Read the pretentious art descriptions and interact with the artworks themselves in this soul-defining journey that unapologetically places toilet humor above all else in life.[/p][p][/p][h3]Interactivity and Secrets[/h3][p]Get close to the art. Touch it. Caress it. Interaction is encouraged, allowing you to learn more about each piece while unlocking secret areas of the museum and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiple Endings[/h3][p]Your journey through the museum will conclude differently depending on how you choose to review the various art pieces within.[/p][p][/p][h3]Art Style[/h3][p]The crude PS1-inspired visuals complement the experimental nature of the game, creating a distinctly eerie and atmospheric experience.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3781500/La_Galerie_des_Toilettes/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Major Language Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have just uploaded a new build which adds support for 17 more languages. We received quite a few mails from people who kindly asked us to have their language supported in the game. Now all those people can enjoy performing virtual colonoscopies.

We wish you all a very happy Thursday!

notes.title: Bugfix 3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. 

A patch has been uploaded that should fix some problems that players have reported to us. The bugs are relate to objects falling outside of the environment when being pulled off the colon wall at specific angles. That bug should now happen a lot less often. I have also fixed a somewhat rare bug that is related to scanning objects at the exact same time as transitioning to another level which then caused the level not being exited at all.

I wish you all a great weekend!

notes.title: Bugfix 2
notes.notes: Hello everyone. The bug in the cinematic scenes should be fixed now for all of you. Please tell me if it is not fixed.

notes.title: Bugfix #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

There was a very ugly bug in the code which prevented some players from seeing our lovely cinematics.

This should now be fixed!
